# Generated CLI capabilities

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.js. Do not edit this file. -->

This page describes BC Atlas 0.5.0.
Run `npm run docs` after a capability changes.

## Commands

| ID | Invocation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capabilities` | `bca capabilities` | Discover this machine contract. |
| `graph` | `bca graph <app-root>` | Write an architecture diagram or model file. |
| `graph.workflow` | `bca graph <app-root>` | Write a bounded workflow diagram. |
| `inspect` | `bca inspect <app-root>` | Read the resolved architecture model. |
| `watch` | `bca watch <app-root>` | Rebuild a diagram when AL source changes. |
| `serve` | `bca serve <app-root>` | Start the combined local Control Center. |
| `mcp` | `bca-mcp` | Expose BC Atlas tools through an MCP stdio server. |
| `docs.list` | `bca docs list <test-root>` | List scenarios. |
| `docs.show` | `bca docs show <test-root>` | Read one scenario. |
| `docs.validate` | `bca docs validate <test-root>` | Validate the documentation corpus. |
| `docs.generate` | `bca docs generate <test-root>` | Generate Markdown. |
| `docs.set` | `bca docs set <test-root>` | Set AL documentation metadata. |
| `docs.unset` | `bca docs unset <test-root>` | Remove AL documentation metadata. |
| `docs.automation` | `bca docs automation <test-root>` | Build a CI automation plan. |
| `docs.glossary` | `bca docs glossary` | Read documentation tag definitions. |
| `docs.serve` | `bca docs serve <test-root>` | Start the docs-only Control Center. |

## Exit codes

- Success: `0`
- Operation failure: `1`
- Usage error: `2`

For all options and examples, read the [CLI reference](../cli-reference.md).
